about: Lines shown on the error page, one at random. Each is a line of Trillion's own voice, with the id naming the piece. Add or remove a row to change what shows.

lines.quote: The whole question is how you accelerate the pursuit of your aim as fast as humanly possible.
Pursuing your aim as fast as possible and breaking through plateaus is universal, so it applies in any domain.
The question is, are you working on the biggest needle mover?
Whatever you're pursuing, Trillion moves you way further, way faster.
It removes what's slowing you down, improves what's left, then accelerates.
There are a hundred things you could do. One will move the needle most.
